component.name: PkgDeck
component.summary: All your package managers in one app

description.p: Search, install, update, and clean up software from every package manager on your computer. PkgDeck works with APT, Flatpak, Snap, Homebrew, developer tools, container images, and firmware updates, and includes the pkd command-line tool.
Choose what automatic updates wait for.

ul.li: Automatic updates and cleaning can run on battery
Automatic updates can run on a metered connection
Automatic cleaning no longer waits for a metered connection

description.p: Better pages for opened Flatpak links.

ul.li: A Flatpak link shows the app's icon, description and screenshots when its repository is set up
A Flatpak link for an app installed for all users offers Update or Reinstall instead of Install
A Flatpak link shows the version it installs instead of its branch
App descriptions keep their paragraphs and show list items one per line
Every section and running change words what it's doing the same way
The tray icon can show always, only with updates, or never
Checks can notify, install updates, or do nothing with them
Automatic updates install only from the sources you pick, and wait on metered connections

description.p: Fixes for opened files, Homebrew Casks and KDE.

ul.li: An opened file for something already installed offers Update, or for Flatpak, Reinstall or Downgrade, instead of Install
Going to another page leaves an opened file's page
Flatpak links open in PkgDeck on KDE
Homebrew Casks searches no longer fail on casks with no version for this system
Header buttons drop their labels before covering the page title
